rules.reason: The name field draws no scroll bar. Chrome's clientWidth of an <input> leaves out its padding (offsetWidth 498, clientWidth 476, border 2, padding 10 + 10), so the rule reads the 20 px of side padding as a vertical scroll bar. The rule cannot tell a padded input from a scroll bar.
